description: This PHP source file defines the 'CandidateHistoryListModel' class, which models and serializes candidate history data for the Recruitment module in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties and methods to convert entity data into an array suitable for API responses, handles interview data, and utilizes traits for helper functions.

classes.name: CandidateHistoryListModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing candidate history data, including interview info, for API responses in the Recruitment module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a CandidateHistory entity and sets up property filters and attribute mappings for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the CandidateHistory entity into an array format, including interview details and editability status.
